name: Read a short practical notice in another language
short_description: Read a short practical notice in another language once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can read a short practical notice in another language in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Read a short practical notice in another language means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Read a short practical notice in another language in a fresh real-life scenario.
